title: Modification of Supplemental Use Provisions
previewText: For mixed buildings, the provisions of Section 32-421 (Limitation on floors occupied by non-residential uses) shall be modified where uses listed under Offices in Use Group VII are located on the same story as a dwelling unit such that the limitations set forth in paragraphs (a) or (b) of such Section need not apply.
